title: FBI-UAP-D014, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-1, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A government-commissioned digital rendering (artistic image) depicting a reported UAP incident, not a primary observational record.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the image file; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the CSV description, not the artefact itself.
This is an artist's rendering, not photographic or sensor evidence — it depicts what a witness described, not what was recorded.
Single-source: based on one federal law enforcement special agent's first-hand account (documented in DOW-UAP-D079), with no independent corroboration in this document.
The specific site and precise location are described only in general terms ('sensitive national security site, western United States').
The rendering was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the reported October 2023 incident.
